audit.skip_reason: Backend/Frontend services not running — static analysis only

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in orchestrator (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.impact: Unauthenticated network-accessible RCE; complete system compromise of orchestrator

escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read/Execution affecting all frontend developers (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.impact: When Vitest UI server is running, arbitrary file read and code execution on developer machines

escalations.title: react-router-dom Open Redirect via protocol-relative URLs (potential auth bypass vector)
escalations.impact: Allows phishing via crafted redirect URLs; potential auth flow manipulation

bugs.title: GET /api/search endpoint not registered — 5 tests will fail on every CI run
bugs.impact: npm test produces 5 failures; DependencyPicker component gets 404 at runtime
bugs.recommendation: Add searchRouter at Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and mount in app.ts

bugs.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md is orphaned — describes a different system with 0% coverage
bugs.impact: Causes false 0% coverage alarm; confuses future audits about spec authority
bugs.recommendation: Archive to docs/archive/ and update inspector.config.yml specs.dir to Plans/

bugs.title: Traceability enforcer blind to FR-dependency-* requirements (16 FRs unscanned by CI)
bugs.impact: FR-dependency-seed and FR-dependency-api-types incomplete items invisible to CI gates
bugs.recommendation: Add --file Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md as second gate in CI or add multi-file support

bugs.title: dependency_check_duration_seconds Histogram missing from metrics.ts (FR-dependency-metrics gap)
bugs.impact: 3/4 required metrics implemented; test suite does not detect the gap
bugs.recommendation: Add Histogram export and corresponding test assertion

bugs.title: Duplicate frontend test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage inflate test count
bugs.impact: Maintenance burden; risk of silent divergence between root and pages/ variants
bugs.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates; keep tests/pages/ variants (richer coverage)

bugs.title: OpenTelemetry tracing completely absent — CLAUDE.md non-negotiable rule violated
bugs.impact: No distributed tracing; zero observability for request lifecycle; CLAUDE.md rule violated
bugs.recommendation: Add FR-WF-014 for OTel + implement @opentelemetry/sdk-node auto-instrumentation OR document explicit deferral

bugs.title: Vite multiple path traversal vulnerabilities — dev server can serve files outside project root
bugs.impact: Dev server file system escape; NTLMv2 hash disclosure on Windows; server.fs.deny bypass
bugs.recommendation: Upgrade vite to 8.0.16+ (major version, coordinate with frontend team)

bugs.title: form-data CRLF injection allows HTTP header manipulation
bugs.impact: Attacker can inject arbitrary HTTP headers via crafted multipart field names
bugs.recommendation: Update form-data to 4.0.6+ (minor patch, low risk)

bugs.title: WebSocket (ws) memory exhaustion DoS via tiny message fragments
bugs.impact: Network attacker can exhaust memory by sending many tiny WebSocket fragments

bugs.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS in orchestrator Express routes
bugs.impact: Crafted URL with many parameters causes exponential regex backtracking; orchestrator DoS
bugs.recommendation: Update express in platform/orchestrator (includes path-to-regexp patch)

bugs.title: @grpc/grpc-js malformed request/compression crashes in orchestrator
bugs.impact: Malformed gRPC messages crash the orchestrator server; network-accessible DoS
bugs.recommendation: Resolved automatically by dockerode 5.0.0+ upgrade (same fix as DEP-001 escalation)

bugs.title: protobufjs code injection/prototype-pollution gadgets (HIGH CVEs co-located with DEP-001)
bugs.impact: Code injection via bytes field defaults, prototype pollution gadgets, process-wide DoS
bugs.recommendation: Resolved automatically by dockerode 5.0.0+ upgrade (same fix as DEP-001 escalation)
